title: Just Optimized
body:
# Just Optimized
**A simple yet effective optimization modpack**

The following mods are included:
- Architectury
- Cloth Config v19
- Clumps
- Cubes Without Borders
- Dynamic FPS
- EntityCulling
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- Iris (1.21.x)
- Mod Menu
- Placeholder API
- Sodium
- YetAnotherConfigLib
- Zoomify

The following shader packs come pre-installed:
- Complementary Reimagined
- BSL Shaders

**Any feedback is welcome. Please join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/53MVVmGPdT) to submit feedback!**
